meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

howto.what: 当提示中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时，Claude会进入严格编码模式：先创建目标、打开笔记本、编写计划，再并行执行、测试先行、证据驱动，最终交付可验证的结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“ultrawork”或“ulw”关键词时触发。如果对话中已存在该指令，则不再重复注入。

say.text: 启用ultrawork模式，帮我修复这个Bug。
say.note: Claude会进入超工作模式，按照严格流程修复Bug。
Claude会生成重构计划并证据驱动执行。

howto.what_en: When a prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude enters a strict coding mode: it creates a goal, opens a notepad, writes a plan, then executes in parallel with test-first, evidence-driven steps, delivering verified work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. If the directive is already in the conversation, it is not injected again.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork mode and fix this bug.
say_en.note: Claude enters ultrawork mode and fixes the bug per the strict process.

say_en.text: Refactor this module using ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: Claude creates a refactoring plan and executes with evidence.
